create_msn_head: create an MSNHead module for self-supervised learning with configurable prototypes and projection layers
build_projection_head: build a projection head with two hidden layers, optional batch normalization, and GELU activations
test_one_hot_encoding: test the one_hot static method that generates smoothed one-hot encoded label tensors
review_forward_pass: review the forward pass that normalizes queries, computes softmax over prototype similarities, and returns soft assignments
initialize_weights: initialize weights of linear layers using truncated normal distribution with zero-initialized biases
